Priority transcript HGVS concordance

VEP is run with --refseq, so all transcript IDs are RefSeq NM_ accessions. MANE Select and MANE Plus Clinical transcripts are defined on GRCh38 and carry RefSeq NM_ identifiers. The same NM_ base accession is typically present in the hg19 RefSeq annotation, sometimes at the same version and sometimes at an older version (e.g. NM_007294.3 in hg19 vs NM_007294.4 in hg38). When the base NM_ accession matches across builds, HGVS comparison is performed on the variant effect (posedit) only, ignoring the version suffix. MANE hg38 only means the MANE-designated NM_ transcript was not annotated for this variant in the hg19 VEP output — no comparison is possible and these variants are excluded from the concordance rate below.

Concordance rates are calculated on the eligible subset: variants where a priority transcript was found in both builds and HGVS terms were available for comparison. Variants with MANE absent in hg19, no matching transcripts, or no HGVS annotation are excluded from the denominator.

MNV allele artifact suppression: Some liftover tools incorrectly normalise multi-nucleotide variants (e.g. REF=GA ALT=AT → REF=G ALT=GT), turning a 2-base substitution into an insertion. When exactly one tool's lifted allele differs from the other two (which agree), the downstream HGVS difference is a representation artifact rather than a real discordance — these are excluded from the mismatch count and do not contribute to CRITICAL scoring. The number of suppressed variants and the outlier tool are shown in the score breakdown. The number of suppressed variants is shown below.

Technical notes

Liftover tools: CrossMap, bcftools +liftover, Picard LiftoverVcf — run independently; concordance compared across all three.

Priority transcript: MANE Select > MANE Plus Clinical > Canonical fallback. MANE is GRCh38-only; hg19 carries the same ENST base ID at an older version — version-mismatched pairs are compared on variant effect (posedit) only. If no matching base ID exists in hg19, the transcript is flagged as MANE hg38 only.

Scoring: HGVS concordance on priority transcript drives prioritization. Clinical evidence (ClinVar) applied as override.

Full results: See accompanying CSV and JSON files for all variant-level data.
